1200	The ear of the bull, after slaughter but before he received the blood, and afterward he received its blood: it is invalid,	A orelha do touro, após a shechitá mas antes de receber o sangue, e depois ele recebeu o sangue: é inválido,
1201	as it says, "and he shall take from the blood of the bull." When he takes the blood, the bull must be as it was	pois está dito: "e tomará do sangue do touro". Ao tomar o sangue, o touro tem de estar como já estava
